name: augmentmereality-rules-tests
description: Local emulator authorization and client-contract tests for web/firestore.rules, plus historical-v2 regression fixtures. These tests do not inspect deployed production rules.

scripts.test: node drift-check.mjs && node --test drift-check.test.mjs && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-amr-rules "node --test --test-force-exit rules.test.mjs && node --test --test-force-exit historical-v2-rules.test.mjs"
